services.title: Technology Stack

crypto.name: Crypto Random Engine
crypto.description: Uses Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues) for cryptographically secure random number generation. No Math.random() anywhere.

excel.name: Excel Processing
excel.description: SheetJS-powered parsing with Web Workers for non-blocking processing of Excel and CSV files containing 1M+ rows of participant data.

auth.name: Telegram OTP Auth
auth.description: Two-layer authentication: daily dynamic access code + Telegram Bot API OTP verification with bcrypt hashing.

animation.name: Cinematic Animation
animation.description: 60-second dramatic winner reveal with Matrix rain, scanning phases, highlight cycling, and spotlight reveal.

security.name: Zero-Backend Security
security.description: All processing happens client-side. No server storage, no database. Refresh clears everything for maximum security.
